title: Site Reliability Engineer
text:
Halcyon Cloud provides managed databases to thousands of developers. As a Site Reliability Engineer you'll keep the fleet fast and available.

In this role you will
- Operate large Kubernetes clusters on GCP and AWS; manage releases with Helm and Argo CD.
- Build infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible.
- Own monitoring and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog; lead incident response and postmortems.
- Automate toil with Go and Python; write Bash where it fits.
- Improve load balancing, networking and DNS for multi-region failover.
- Drive capacity planning and fault tolerance reviews with service teams.

Qualifications
- 4+ years in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure roles.
- Deep Linux knowledge and comfort debugging under pressure.
- Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins or GitHub Actions).
- Experience running PostgreSQL or MySQL in production is a plus.
- On-call participation required (one week in six).
